description: Source code implementing memory page mapping, unmapping, trimming, purging, and mmap-based chunk allocation for jemalloc.

methods.name: pages_map
methods.description: Maps memory pages at a specified address and size, using platform-specific APIs.

methods.name: pages_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps memory pages at a specified address and size, platform-specific.

methods.name: pages_trim
methods.description: Trims a mapped memory region to a specified size and lead size.

methods.name: pages_purge
methods.description: Purges unused pages in a memory region, platform-specific.

methods.name: chunk_alloc_mmap_slow
methods.description: Allocates memory with specific alignment using mmap, with fallback to over-sized mapping and trimming.

methods.name: chunk_alloc_mmap
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory chunks using mmap, with fallback to slow method if necessary.

methods.name: chunk_dealloc_mmap
methods.description: Deallocates memory chunks allocated via mmap, platform-specific.
